observations: One small, low resolution photo of a light grey office printer wrapped in clear plastic, sitting on another wrapped unit.
Photo 0 shows an 'hp' logo on the front left of the machine; the small product line text beside it is too blurred to read.
The top looks like a scanner unit over a print body, consistent with a multifunction printer.
Advertising flyers (one with a Pepsi logo) are stuffed under the plastic wrap and cover most of the front, hiding any model badge and control panel.
A watermark reading 'ACHANOS ... NIG LTD' crosses the photo, so it looks like a dealer's photo.
No model number, rating plate, control panel, page count or toner level is visible.
No photo of the machine powered on or of a printed page.

read_from: photo 0 front logo (brand only, model unreadable)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an HP machine shaped like a multifunction printer, but no model badge or colour toner is visible to confirm it prints in colour.

claims.claim: Fastest in-class two-sided printing speed and first page out
claims.evidence: This is manufacturer marketing text; speed cannot be judged from a still photo and the model is not readable.

risks.risk: Model unknown; HP multifunction printers range from small home units to large office machines, and the model sets the price.
risks.proof: Clear close photo of the model badge on the front and the rating plate on the back.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until the model is read

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, print, scan or copy.
risks.proof: Clip of the machine powering on, printing a configuration page and copying one sheet.

risks.risk: High page count or worn drum and fuser.
risks.proof: Photo of the printed configuration or supplies status page showing total page count.
risks.if_unproven: as high mileage needing a fuser

risks.proof: Photo with the front door open showing all four toner cartridges in place, and the supplies page levels.

risks.risk: Dealer photo may not show the unit sold, and flyers hide damage.
risks.proof: Photo of the unit unwrapped from all sides with a handwritten note of today's date on it.
risks.if_unproven: priced only on the agent's inspection before payment

proof_requests: Close photo of the model badge on the front and the rating plate on the back.
Clip of the machine powering on, printing a configuration page and making a copy.
Photo of the configuration or supplies page showing page count and toner levels.
Photo with the front door open showing the toner cartridges.
Photos of the unit unwrapped from all sides with a handwritten note of today's date.
response.reason: Only the HP brand is readable; the model, which sets the price across a very wide range of HP multifunction printers, is hidden by the flyers and too blurred to read, so not even a worst case price can be set.
